tooltipContent:
HOI4 engine mod-loading rules:
1. If a mod file doesn't clash with vanilla, both load.
2. If they clash, the mod's file wins.
3. replace_path folders in descriptor.mod fully replace vanilla.
4. If a sub-mod clashes with the main mod, the sub-mod wins.

Image resolution here follows the same order: your project's own pictures first, then vanilla files on disk, then a fuzzy name match — for example, a decision's icon = X maps to GFX_decision_X.

expandBody: After this completes, the main view stays on your current primary country — it won't jump to <mono>{tag}</mono>. To see {tag} content, switch to it from the country switcher in the sidebar.
timeHintBody: Large mods (Fire Rise / RT56 / KR) take about 30-90s to re-scan. Keep this dialog open until it finishes.
ackExpand: I understand: this expands the project's country list (a secondary country), it does not switch the primary country, and the main view stays unchanged.

importWarning.not_loaded_by_game: {file} was not imported — the game only reads the files directly in {folder}/, not the ones in its subfolders.
importWarning.parser_recovery_stray_rbrace: {path} line {line}: ignored an unmatched closing brace and continued reading.
importWarning.parser_recovery_empty_value: {path} line {line}: {key} has no value before {terminator}; it was kept empty so the surrounding block could close.
importWarning.loc_entry_unpreserved: One localisation entry in {file} at line {line} could not be preserved; the remaining entries imported normally.
importWarning.parse_skipped: Couldn't read {file} — it was skipped, and the rest imported fine.
importWarning.state_skipped: Skipped one state in {file} that couldn't be read — the rest imported fine.
importWarning.character_multi_instance: Character {tag} has {count} DLC variant versions. The editor shows the first one; the others are kept intact and come back unchanged when you export. Use the Script Editor to tweak the extra versions.
importWarning.bookmark_no_name: Skipped a bookmark that had no usable name — nothing else was affected.
importWarning.super_event_bad_id: Skipped a super-event with an unusual id ({id}) — nothing else was affected.
importWarning.decision_skipped_blocks: Skipped {count} block(s) in a decisions file that weren't decision categories: {preview}.
importWarning.no_content_characters: A file in the Characters folder had no characters in it — skipped.
importWarning.no_content_technologies: A file in the Technologies folder had no technologies in it — skipped.
importWarning.no_content_ideas: A file in the Ideas folder had no ideas in it — skipped.
importWarning.no_content_events: A file in the Events folder had no events in it — skipped.
importWarning.no_content_focus: A file in the focus tree folder had no focus trees in it — skipped.
importWarning.no_content_decision_categories: A file in the Decisions folder had no decision categories in it — skipped.
importWarning.no_content_decisions: A file in the Decisions folder had no decisions in it — skipped.
importWarning.import_parse_error: Couldn't parse {file} — it was skipped; the rest imported fine.
importWarning.import_entity_failed: Couldn't import {entity} — it was skipped; the rest imported fine.
importWarning.import_gfx_parse_failed: Couldn't read the image (.gfx) definitions — icons may not auto-match, but everything else imported fine.
importWarning.import_build_skipped: Couldn't run {step} — your content imported fine; only this optional step was skipped.
importWarning.import_registry_merge_failed: Couldn't add the imported custom ideologies to the selectable registry — your content imported fine; you can still pick them manually.
importWarning.read_failed: Could not read {path} — it was skipped; the rest imported fine.
importWarning.decode_failed: Could not read {path} — it was skipped; the rest imported fine.
importWarning.unrouted_dir: {count} file(s) under {dir}/ are not edited here — they stay in your original mod, untouched.
importWarning.goal_icons_unmatched: None of the {count} focus icons matched an imported image — focus icons may not appear; the rest imported fine.
importWarning.ideology_reconcile_failed: Could not align ruling-party ideology from the history files — you can set it in the workbench; the rest imported fine.
importWarning.gfx_cache_write_failed: Image matching for the second stage may be skipped — your content imported fine.
importWarning.raid_deps_not_carried: Your raid files are preserved, but the {loc_count} text key(s) and {sprite_count} sprite(s) they reference are not — only vanilla ones will resolve in game (e.g. {sample}). Add the mod's localisation/ and interface/ definitions as raw override files if the raids are custom.
importWarning.raid_user_override_kept: Kept your own {file} — the imported mod has a file at the same path, but your version wins. Delete your raw override file first if you want the mod's version.
importWarning.raid_path_unsafe: Skipped the raid file {file} — its path isn't a valid mod-relative file path, so it can't be preserved.
importWarning.unit_path_unsafe: Skipped the unit file {file} — its path isn't a valid mod-relative file path, so it can't be preserved.
importWarning.unit_user_override_kept: Kept your own {file} — the imported mod has a file at the same path, but your version wins. Delete your raw override file first if you want the mod's version.
importWarning.unit_equipment_emit_wins: {file} was not preserved — the program generates a file with that exact name from your Equipment workbench, and HOI4 loads every file in common/units/equipment/, so keeping both would define the same equipment twice. Edit the equipment in the workbench, or rename the file in your mod first.
importWarning.unit_oob_renamed_to_avoid_collision: Your {original} is preserved as {file} — this project's Division Templates already generate an order of battle with the original name. HOI4 only loads the OOB a country's history points at, so your copy is kept for reference without overriding it.
importWarning.parser_recovery_unclosed_block: {path}, line {line}: a block opened here is never closed (the file ends at line {eof_line}); it was closed at end of file so the content could be read.
